Container.Name: Hermitage
Container.Overview: Hermitage is a modern Navidrome/OpenSubsonic web client with immersive Now Playing, synced lyrics, live spectrum visualisation, artwork-driven themes, queue and playlist management, responsive ultrawide layouts, PWA support and a desktop-first library interface.
Container.Requires: An existing Navidrome/OpenSubsonic server reachable from the Hermitage container.
Container.Changes: v0.6.2: improved mobile immersive layout and iPhone/PWA viewport handling; portrait Lyrics now uses compact artwork to leave more room for synced lyrics.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent encrypted sessions and Hermitage server data.

Config.Name: Navidrome URL
Config.Description: Navidrome/OpenSubsonic base URL as reachable from this container.

Config.Name: Lock Navidrome URL
Config.Description: Hide server selection from the login screen and force the configured Navidrome URL.

Config.Name: Allowed Navidrome Hosts
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated hostname/IP allow-list. Do not include ports.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Set true only when Hermitage is accessed exclusively over HTTPS.

Config.Name: Persistent Artwork Cache Items
Config.Description: Maximum persistent artwork renditions retained under /data/cover-cache.

Config.Name: Login Rate Limit
Config.Description: Failed login attempts allowed per client IP in five minutes.

Config.Name: Trust Proxy
Config.Description: Express trust-proxy value. 1 is suitable when one reverse proxy sits in front of Hermitage.
